# 🏆 GitHub Achievement Badges Progress

## 🎯 Available Achievements

### ⭐ Quickdraw
**How to earn:** Close an issue or PR within 5 minutes of opening
**Status:** 🟡 In Progress
**Tip:** We have auto-release workflow that can trigger quickly!

### 🌟 Pair Extraordinaire  
**How to earn:** Co-author commits on merged PR
**Status:** 🟡 In Progress
**Tip:** Use `Co-authored-by:` in commit messages

### 🚀 Galaxy Brain
**How to earn:** Get accepted answer in Discussions
**Status:** ⚪ Not Started
**Tip:** Enable Discussions and answer questions

### 💎 YOLO
**How to earn:** Merge PR without review
**Status:** ⚪ Not Started
**Tip:** Merge your own PRs (use with caution!)

### 🌲 Pull Shark
**How to earn:** Merged pull requests (Bronze: 2, Silver: 16, Gold: 128)
**Status:** 🟡 In Progress
**Tip:** Create and merge feature PRs regularly

### ⚡ Starstruck
**How to earn:** Repository stars (Bronze: 16, Silver: 128, Gold: 512)
**Status:** 🟡 In Progress
**Tip:** Make your project awesome and promote it!
